eurekagent-dog-breed-identification.reason: No licensed public copy of the same data. The competition is a 120-breed subset of ImageNet taken from the Stanford Dogs dataset (MLE-bench description: 'a strictly canine subset of ImageNet', acknowledgement to the Stanford Dogs creators). The Stanford Dogs page states no licence and says the dataset was built from ImageNet images and annotations, which ImageNet distributes under non-commercial research terms; Hugging Face copies (e.g. Voxel51/StanfordDogs, amaye15/stanford-dogs) state no licence. Without pretrained weights (ImageNet-pretrained ones would also have seen these images) a CPU-only 120-class fine-grained task would not measure the competition's capability.

eurekagent-tabular-playground-may-2022.reason: Kaggle-generated synthetic data ('(simulated) manufacturing control data', MLE-bench description) with no named source dataset and no public generator; the rows exist only on Kaggle, which is not accessible here (no credentials, no redistribution).

eurekagent-the-icml-2013-whale-redux.reason: Duplicate of loongflow-the-icml-2013-whale-challenge-right-whale-redux: EurekAgent evaluates MLE-bench Lite, whose list (experiments/splits/low.txt) contains the-icml-2013-whale-challenge-right-whale-redux and no other whale competition. Withdrawn for the same reason as that task (labelled clip set only on Kaggle).

loongflow-aerial-cactus-identification.reason: The competition data are resized 32 x 32 thumbnails of the authors' Kaggle dataset irvingvasquez/cactus-aerial-photos (MLE-bench description, acknowledgement); no copy outside Kaggle was found (Zenodo and Hugging Face searches for the cactus aerial photos returned none), and Kaggle downloads need credentials that are not available.

loongflow-detecting-insults-in-social-co.reason: Impermium's 2012 recruiting-competition data are distributed only through Kaggle; no copy with a stated licence was found (Hugging Face search for 'insult'/'impermium' and Zenodo search returned unrelated datasets).

loongflow-dogs-vs-cats-redux-kernels-edi.reason: The images are Microsoft Research's Asirra/Petfinder photographs. The Hugging Face card of microsoft/cats_vs_dogs (pointing to Microsoft's download page) gives the licence as 'unknown' and its licensing section as 'More Information Needed'; Microsoft's download page (details.aspx?id=54765) returned HTTP 403 to this machine and was not retried by another route. Under the rule that the data must be public under a stated licence, the task is withdrawn; it would be implementable (seeded split, from-scratch log loss) only if the owner accepts unlicensed data.

loongflow-google-quest-challenge.reason: The 30 crowd-sourced subjective labels were released only with the Kaggle competition; the GitHub repository google-research-datasets/quest is archived and empty (size 0, last push 2018, before the competition) and no other copy with a licence was found.

loongflow-plant-pathology-2020-fgvc7.reason: The data paper (Thapa et al. 2020, Applications in Plant Sciences, PMC7526434) states that the image dataset is available on Kaggle only and gives no image licence (the CC BY licence covers the article); the authors' GitHub repository rthapa-26/FGVC-Plant-Pathology-2020-challenge-dataset- holds code only and no licence; no Zenodo or Hugging Face copy of this year's images was found.

loongflow-plant-pathology-2021-fgvc8.reason: Outside Kaggle only third-party Hugging Face re-uploads exist (timm/plant-pathology-2021: 16,768 + 1,864 images = the competition training set, 16.1 GB, licence field apache-2.0 asserted by the uploader without provenance; Elapsedf/Plant-Pathology: 10.8 GB zip, MIT asserted, no description). A self-asserted licence on a re-upload is not a licence from the data's creators, and the size exceeds the 2 GB per-task data limit.

loongflow-predict-volcanic-eruptions-ing.reason: INGV's seismic segments are distributed only through Kaggle (Zenodo and Hugging Face searches found no copy), and the competition asks participants not to seek further metadata about the sensors; the waveform set is tens of GB (size not verified here, Kaggle not accessible), beyond the 2 GB per-task limit.

loongflow-tabular-playground-series-dec-.reason: The rows were synthesised by Kaggle with a CTGAN trained on the Forest Cover Type data (MLE-bench description) and exist only on Kaggle. UCI Covertype (CC BY 4.0) is the GAN's source, not the competition data: a different distribution and size, i.e. a separate classic benchmark rather than this task, so it is not substituted under this id.

loongflow-the-icml-2013-whale-challenge-.reason: The labelled 2-second clip set (train2.zip, test2.zip; four days of training and three days of test recordings from Cornell's MARU archive) is distributed only through Kaggle. Public North Atlantic right whale recordings exist (e.g. the CC BY 4.0 PAMGuard tutorial subset on Zenodo 13880107 from 2009 Cape Cod Bay MARU data, and a NOAA NCEI annotation archive cited there, licence not checked), but clips cut from them would be a new analogue with a different sampling and labelling protocol, not a recreation; not built in this package.
